summary: Apollo V1 iteration-3 PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases (16 new /app/backend/tests/test_family.py + 14 regression /app/backend/tests/test_apollo_backend.py). Family Sharing: POST /api/family/guardians accepts delivered@resend.dev via Emergent-managed email and returns {guardian_id, confirmed:false}; 4th guardian on same device_id → 400 'Up to 3 trusted family members'; invalid email → 422; DELETE removes and list confirms removal. GET /api/family/confirm/{token} — token pulled from Mongo (DB_NAME=test_database) collection `guardians` → HTMLResponse containing 'now receiving'; garbage token → HTML 'no longer valid'. POST /api/family/pair returns 6-char code; POST /api/family/link marries dev-B to dev-A, second use of same code → 404, self-link → 400. GET /api/family/links returns i_watch=[{owner_name:'Alex'}] on dev-B and watching_me=1 on dev-A. Patrol fanout: barking event on dev-A appears in /api/family/shared-events?device_id=dev-B within 2.5s with headline+from_label='Alex'; a 'resting' event is correctly NOT shared. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844 mobile viewport, fresh localStorage): Onboarding (onboarding-start-button) → /privacy-disclosure (disclosure-accept-button) → Home; home-digest-card shows 'A quiet week' → /digest exposes digest-headline='A quiet week', digest-summary (94 chars), 6 digest-stat-* tiles; digest-close returns. Settings → settings-family → family-make-code produces 6-char family-pair-code ('CRNQZJ' on this run); adding delivered@resend.dev via family-add-guardian creates a family-guardian-* row with 'Awaiting confirmation' and can be removed; entering 'ZZZZZZ' in family-link-code + family-link-button shows family-error 'Code not found or expired'. Settings → settings-dev-tools → dev-adapter-OPEN_WIFI: Home hero becomes 'growling' with an 'open Wi‑Fi' Patrol event; Guard tab guard-network reads 'Open Wi‑Fi (no password).' and guard-wifi-pill = 'Wi‑Fi: open'. Toggling NORMAL then OPEN_WIFI again does not spawn additional distinct events (event_id-based upsert). dev-adapter-CAPTIVE_PORTAL surfaces the 'sign in first' Patrol event. Settings → settings-benchmark: two runs produce benchmark-history with benchmark-chart, benchmark-bar-0 and benchmark-bar-1 visible; benchmark-clear-history empties the section. Regression: /check?url=http://testsafebrowsing.appspot.com/s/phishing.html&source=link → check-result-state 'Apollo is barking'; Ask suggestion 0 streams a full multi-line Apollo reply visibly (screenshot verified). No React Native red screens, no deprecated Expo packages introduced, no console errors of concern.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `notify_guardians` swallows all exceptions with a single warning — good for safety, but consider adding structured logging (recipient hash + event_id) to aid audit of the 5/day cap.

server.py:407 fanout is fired only on INSERT, not on UPDATE — this is correct today (event_id-based upsert wouldn't re-notify) but a devicewide 'resend' path may be desirable if a barking event is later escalated to biting; currently no code path emits a new fanout on state transitions via PATCH /api/patrol/events/{event_id}.

server.py `add_guardian` inserts the guardian row before send_email; if send_email raises non-HTTPException the row remains inserted (only HTTPException triggers cleanup). Consider broadening the except clause.

server.py `list_links` returns owner_name via `l.get('owner_name','')` — always defaults to '' when the pairing was created with an empty owner_name; UI copies rely on a friendly label, which is fine but worth verifying the family screen does not render an empty tag.

frontend `ask-message-*` testID pattern is missing on message bubbles — SSE streaming clearly works (verified visually) but automated regression on Ask message DOM would be more robust with a dedicated testID on each message bubble.
